title: A different story. A stable starting point.

claim_limits: Visibility includes proposals and does not establish canon status.

The branch assertion proves parent-claim pinning; shared-library tracking and banking are separate.

No live services, models, application UI, authentication, deployment or narrative quality were tested.
A canon receipt records an operator decision; it does not independently validate story truth or coherence.
